stem.text: The diagram shows a sketch of a wave pattern over a short period of time.

stem.alt: Sketch of a wave pattern made of repeated closely spaced curved lines, with a horizontal double-headed arrow labelled 1.0 m between two dashed reference lines.

stem.text: Which description of this wave is correct?

A.text: The wave is longitudinal, has a wavelength of $20\,\text{cm}$ and is stationary.

B.text: The wave is transverse, has a wavelength of $20\,\text{cm}$ and is stationary.

C.text: The wave is transverse, has a wavelength of $40\,\text{cm}$ and is progressive.

D.text: The wave is transverse, has a wavelength of $40\,\text{cm}$ and is stationary.
